scenarios.name: Happy path
scenarios.description: English caller asks to complete the 2030 CQA over the phone, authenticates with their Census ID and completes it.

scenarios.name: Alternate path 1
scenarios.description: English caller asks several questions that need no authentication; answers come from knowledge, with "anything else?" in between.

scenarios.name: Alternate path 2
scenarios.description: English caller authenticates, completes part of the CQA, is routed to a live agent who receives the context and continues.

scenarios.name: Alternate path 3
scenarios.description: Spanish caller without a Census ID fails authentication three times and is passed to an agent with their intent and where they got stuck.

assumptions.statement: Authentication succeeds on any ONE of Census ID, home zip code or last four SSN digits (the slide says "either"; the owner decided any one is enough).
The Auth Failure wording on the slide reads "Can you please provide please provide"; the owner approved the corrected wording used here.
Census respondent records live in a DynamoDB table.
"If already authenticated, skip, otherwise send through authentication" means the Authentication step is skipped once the caller has authenticated in the same call.
assumptions.source: slide 1, note on "Authentication required for intent?"

assumptions.statement: The "Anything Else" Yes branch returns to the intent check, so a later request that needs authentication is gated again unless already authenticated.

unmapped.description: Alternate Path 4: caller speaks French; the IVR detects French, collects the call reason, translates it and passes the intent to a French-speaking agent. Deferred by the owner; French is not modelled.
